editorial: '### N-Queens


  This problem evaluates core techniques in Backtracking. Implement an optimal algorithm ensuring correct boundary handling.


  - **Time Complexity:** O(N) or O(N log N) depending on the core operation.

  - **Space Complexity:** O(1) or O(N) auxiliary space.'
starterCode: "import java.util.*;\n\npublic class Main {\n    public static List<List<String>> solveNQueens(int n) {\n        return new ArrayList<>();\n    }\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);\n        if (!sc.hasNext()) return;\n        int n = sc.nextInt();\n        List<List<String>> res = solveNQueens(n);\n        if (res != null) {\n            for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) System.out.print((i > 0 ? \" \" : \"\") + res.get(i));\n            System.out.println();\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
solutionCode: "import java.util.*;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.Arrays;\nimport java.util.List;\n\npublic class Main {\n    \n    public static List<List<String>> solveNQueens(int n){\n        List<List<String>> result=new ArrayList<>();\n        boolean[] cols=new boolean[n];\n        boolean[] diag1=new boolean[2*n-1];\n        boolean[] diag2=new boolean[2*n-1];\n        int[] queens=new int[n];\n\n        backtrack(0, n, queens, cols, diag1, diag2, result);\n        return result;\n    }\n    public static void backtrack(int row,int n,int[] queens,\n        boolean[] cols,boolean[] diag1,boolean[] diag2,List<List<String>> result){\n\n            if(row==n){\n                result.add(buildBoard(queens,n));\n            }\n            for(int col=0;col<n;col++){\n                int d1=row-col+n-1;\n                int d2=row+col;\n                if(cols[col] || diag1[d1] || diag2[d2]) continue;\n\n                cols[col]=diag1[d1]=diag2[d2]=true;\n\n         \
  \       queens[row]=col;\n                backtrack(row+1,n,queens,cols,diag1,diag2,result);\n                cols[col]=diag1[d1]=diag2[d2]=false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        public static List<String> buildBoard(int[] queens,int n){\n            List<String> board=new ArrayList<>();\n            for(int row=0;row<n;row++){\n                char[] line=new char[n];\n                Arrays.fill(line, '.');\n                line[queens[row]]='Q';\n                board.add(new String(line));\n            }\n            return board;\n        }\n        private static void printSolutions(List<List<String>> solutions){\n        for (int s = 0; s < solutions.size(); s++) {\n            System.out.println(\"Solution \" + (s + 1) + \":\");\n            for (String row : solutions.get(s)) {\n                System.out.println(row.replace(\"Q\", \"Q \").replace(\".\", \". \"));\n            }\n            System.out.println();\n        }\n        }\n    \n    \n    public static void main(String[]\
  \ args) {\n        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);\n        if (!sc.hasNext()) return;\n        int n = sc.nextInt();\n        List<List<String>> res = solveNQueens(n);\n        if (res != null) {\n            for (int i = 0; i < res.size(); i++) System.out.print((i > 0 ? \" \" : \"\") + res.get(i));\n            System.out.println();\n        }\n    }\n}"
